title: Refuse an assistant message the provider never finished
rationale: The recorded incident (capsule c_85b98eccd858bec2) shows one MODEL_REQUEST at node 16384 and no terminal frame: the provider stopped mid-stream. The client folded the partial message and returned it as complete, so the tool call it had started was carried forward with no recorded result. The repair makes an unfinished message an error at the point it is read, which is the earliest place the evidence still says what happened.
risk: A provider that legitimately ends a stream without [DONE] would now raise; the incident shows one that does, and the guard is the point, but a provider quirk would surface as an error rather than as silent partial data.
Callers that catch broad exceptions around read_stream() would see a different exception type.
The change does not add a retry: a refused message is still a failed call for the user.
